post_approval_implementation_acceptance_: Trigger JSON without header; clock zero/unavailable waits without action while existing steady deadline expires.
Pin positive t_A once; exact TF polls retain it; late TF sends planner once; re-arm does not resend.
Active attempt identity changes before action and blocks action.
Planner request uses send-time ROS stamp distinct from t_A.
Only exact matched SUCCEEDED planner result creates path context; stale/wrong/canceled results reject.
Adapter path_sequence increments at path admission and steady receipt is recorded; path is immutable and invalidated on replacement/cancel/preempt/end/failure.
SafetyLifecycle _set increments revision; ordinary refresh does not; source/tuple/counter/event mismatch fails closed.
Phase B pins t_vector, t_tf=t_odom, records and correlations; future/post-cutoff records and pending replacement reject.
Freshness/deadline/context are checked at acquisition and after transform at commit; rollback/context events cannot resurrect pending data.
can_transform true plus lookup exception cannot commit and retains the original cause; raw path is unchanged.
Missing temporal source pin or configured age rejects without fallback; changed static binding requires compiler validation and a recomputed global config_hash.
Existing five-vector 81D, navigation-success, QoS, Safety, and complete evidence acceptance remains unchanged.
C++ MessageInfo callback GID matches exactly one endpoint pinned by topic/type/node namespace/name/QoS for one invocation/collector session; no rebind.

Missing/unsupported metadata, endpoint ambiguity/multiplicity, GID change, stale/malformed admitted-copy artifact, bounded queue overflow, or atomic publication/readback failure blocks Python temporal admission.
Admitted lifecycle artifact becomes available before Gate-B completion, C++ finalize, or navigation result; Python temporal logic consumes only this artifact.

Config compiler includes navigation.temporal_coherence_contract in the existing global hash, rejects wrong/missing ID/digest/scope/policy, and preserves old serialization/hash for profiles omitting the member.
